source: Two independent sources, byte-identical: (A) kobe v4.0.0 release binary `kobe mnemonic encrypt --json -r` run in a temporary git worktree at tag v4.0.0; (B) scripts/vectors/camouflage-generate.ts (node:crypto pbkdf2Sync + @scure/bip39). Regenerate B with `bun run camouflage-generate.ts` in scripts/vectors; A outputs were captured to /tmp/v4-cases.json at generation time.
note: Camouflage algorithm v1: E' = E XOR PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256(password.as_bytes(), 'kobe-mnemonic-camouflage-v1', 600_000, |E|), re-encoded as BIP-39. Passwords are raw UTF-8 bytes; encrypt requires NFC, decrypt is byte-for-byte.
